result:
Took the strategic-account tagging off Vorort Systeme KG — that assignment, on that company, and nothing else.

Before I touched it I read the record's full tag assignments rather than the record view, because a retired word is not drawn on a list. Your colleague was right: there is a conference word on it. It reads K5 Conference 2025, and it is retired, which is exactly why you could not see one.

The Strategic Account tag itself is untouched; three other accounts keep it, and they should.
